author: NASS
description:
Step into the streets of 1940s Los Angeles after dark and experience the city as few have ever seen it. Captured from a moving vehicle, this rare historical footage reveals glowing streetlights, busy railroads, vintage automobiles, illuminated storefronts, and the unique atmosphere of nighttime Los Angeles during the golden age of America.

If you enjoy historical restorations like this, please Like, Comment, and Subscribe to support future projects.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound design created for immersive atmosphere

B&W Video Source: Internet Archive
